# AI Sec Tester

AI Sec Tester is a chatbot security scanner from The Souls of AI. It runs automated,
OWASP LLM Top-10 aligned prompt-injection and jailbreak checks against an AI chatbot you
own or are authorized to test, then returns a Pass/Fail security scorecard with evidence
per finding and plain-language remediation guidance — in seconds.

## Who it's for

- Product and engineering teams shipping customer-facing AI chatbots and assistants
- Security engineers and consultants running defensive LLM assessments
- Founders who need proof their chatbot is resilient before an attacker probes it

## Key capabilities

- Prompt injection detection (OWASP LLM01) — crafted messages that override instructions
- Insecure output handling (OWASP LLM02) — unsafe content returned to the consuming page
- Sensitive information disclosure (OWASP LLM06) — secrets, keys, or other users' data
- System prompt leakage (OWASP LLM07) — extraction of hidden system prompts and business logic
- Excessive agency (OWASP LLM08) — tools/actions the bot shouldn't be allowed to take
- Common jailbreak / guardrail-bypass patterns
- Pass/Fail scorecard, branded PDF audit report, and remediation guidance

## Pricing at a glance

- Basic — $10 one-time per scan: Level 1 automated scan, 5 OWASP LLM checks, scorecard + PDF
- Pro — $10/month (or $50 one-time annual report): recurring monthly scans, history & trend tracking
- Enterprise — $499 one-time per chatbot: authorization-gated human review, full report + 1 re-scan

## Compliance

Defensive use only. Scan chatbots you own or are explicitly authorized to test. Checks are
non-invasive and aligned with the OWASP Top-10 for LLM Applications.
